name: Consultar documentos compartidos y confirmar sus revisiones
description: From the proposal and document manager, the administrator consults the same document identity, current package and history. A new reviewed package preserves its prior versions and linked client/project: with split contracts, service approval off confirms the product contract plus active annexes; on confirms product and service contracts plus active annexes. The approval preview and custom-document requirements expose only the required contract types. Editing structured sources or replacing enabled draft attachments remains possible. A stale source or failed confirmation preserves the selected switch, draft and current approved package until an explicit retry succeeds.
